justification: `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/Validate.java` is a 1280-line utility class with 51 `public static` methods and no instance state, and it mixes several separable responsibilities in one type: range checks (`exclusiveBetween`, `inclusiveBetween`), type checks (`isAssignableFrom`, `isInstanceOf`), boolean/state checks (`isTrue`, `validState`), regex checks (`matchesPattern`), null/emptiness/blank checks (`notNull`, `notEmpty`, `notBlank`, `noNullElements`), and index validation (`validIndex`). `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ValidateTest.java` is also very large (1645 lines), reflecting the broad API surface. This indicates insufficient modularization.
